about.noAnalyticsSub: The app contains no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting libraries. This review build has no purchases and no billing.
about.description: {{app}} helps small businesses keep track of use-by, best-before, expiry and internal dates for items bought in, opened and prepared, and shows what needs attention next. It records the dates and rules you enter; it does not decide whether food is fit to eat or sell.

backup.subtitle: Your products, dates and settings in one encrypted file

pw.warning: The file is encrypted with this password. If you lose the password, the backup cannot be opened by anyone, including us.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.createHint: Everything in all your workspaces goes into one file, encrypted with a password you choose. Without the password nobody can open it, including us. Save the file somewhere off this phone, such as your cloud drive or email.
backup.demoNotice: You are in the demo. Leave the demo to back up or restore your own data. Demo data is never included in a backup.
backup.restoreHint: Choose a TillExpiry backup file. You will see what is in it before anything on this phone changes.
backup.notIncluded: Not included: reminders already scheduled on this phone (they are planned again after a restore), the demo, and the app language.

err.unexpected: Something went wrong. Nothing on this phone was changed.
err.demoActive: Leave the demo first. Backup and restore work only with your own data.
err.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read.
err.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a TillExpiry backup.
err.invalidJson: This is not a backup file, or it is damaged.
err.notTillExpiry: This file is not a TillExpiry backup.
err.tillCalcBackup: This is a TillCalc backup. It can only be restored in TillCalc.
err.tillNoteBackup: This is a Till Note backup. It can only be restored in Till Note.
err.otherAppBackup: This backup is from another app. It cannot be restored in TillExpiry.
err.unsupportedVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of TillExpiry. Update the app and try again.
err.invalidContent: The backup file is damaged or has been changed.
err.wrongPassphrase: Wrong password, or the file has been changed.
err.keyNotAllowed: The backup contains data TillExpiry does not accept. Nothing was restored.
err.recordInvalid: Some records in the backup are damaged or inconsistent. Nothing was restored.
err.emptyBackup: There is no workspace in this file to restore.
err.nothingToBackUp: There is nothing to back up yet. Create a workspace first.
err.writeFailed: The backup file could not be saved on this phone.
err.snapshotFailed: The current data could not be saved aside before restoring, so nothing was changed.
err.restoreRolledBack: The restore failed. Your previous data has been put back.
err.rollbackFailed: The restore failed and your previous data could not be put back yet. Close and reopen the app: it will put your previous data back when it starts.
err.backupBlocked: No backup file was made. Some stored records are damaged or inconsistent, so a complete backup is not possible: {{categories}}. Nothing was shared.
err.recoveryRequired: An earlier restore still has to be finished or undone. Close and reopen the app, then try again. Nothing was changed.
err.restoreUnconfirmed: The restore could not be confirmed. Close and reopen the app now, before making any changes: it will then show either your previous data or the whole backup, never a mix.

import.subtitle: From a CSV file

intro.products: Add or update products from a CSV file (for example saved from Excel). Nothing is saved until you check the preview and confirm.
intro.batches: Add dated batches from a CSV file (for example saved from Excel). Each row becomes its own batch. Nothing is saved until you check the preview and confirm.

columnsHint.products: Columns the app understands: name, barcode, barcode role, SKU, category, supplier, unit, cost, selling price, currency, usual location, usual date kind, notes. The first row must be the column names.
columnsHint.batches: Columns the app understands: product name, barcode or SKU, date kind, date (YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM for month-only), time, lot, quantity, quantity unit, location, received, cost, notes. The first row must be the column names.

import.limits: Up to {{rows}} rows and {{mb}} MB per file.
import.encodingNote: This file is not UTF-8. It was read as Windows (Excel) text. Check that accented letters and currency signs look right in the preview.
import.columnsHelp: Check what each column holds. The app guessed from the column names; change anything that is wrong. Columns set to "Not imported" are left out.
import.dateOrderHint: Dates written as YYYY-MM-DD are always read correctly. The app never guesses the order of day and month.
import.defaultKind: Kind of date for rows without one
import.defaultKindRequired: What kind of date is in this file?
import.defaultKindHint: Used only for rows with no date kind whose product has no usual date kind. A use-by date needs a real day, not only a month.
import.defaultKindMissing: Choose the kind of date, or map a date kind column. Rows without a kind cannot be imported.
import.moneyCurrency: Amounts are read as {{currency}}, the currency of this workspace, exactly as written. Amounts in another currency are refused.
import.decimalHint: Thousands separators are not accepted, so an amount can never be misread.
import.onExisting: When a row matches an existing product with different details
import.onDuplicate: When a row is identical to another row or to a batch you already have

duplicate.import: Import it as a separate batch

import.neverMerged: Batches are never merged: rows with a different lot, date, location or quantity always become separate batches, even with the same barcode.

count.conflicts: Rows that differ from an existing product

import.errorsNotImported: Rows with problems are not imported. Fix them in the file and import it again, or import the rest now.
import.atomicHint: Everything is saved together in one step: if anything fails, nothing is saved.

result.title: Import finished
result.hint: The import is saved in the import history. Importing the same file again is blocked.

help.title: Help
help.guideIntro: Short steps for the everyday jobs.

start.title: Getting started
start.l1: {{app}} has five tabs: Today, Items, Add, Reports and More. The business name at the top switches between your businesses.
start.l2: Each business keeps its own products, dated items, places, rules and reports. Add, switch or hide a business in More → Businesses.
start.l3: The business type (retail, food preparation, both, or home and other) only changes suggestions. You can change it later without losing data.
start.l4: More → Try the demo opens a separate sample shop and kitchen. Nothing you do there touches your own records, and you can reset it at any time.
start.l5: Search at the top finds products, dated items, places, rules and suppliers in the current business.
start.l6: More → Language: English, Arabic (right to left), Turkish, French, Spanish or German.

adding.title: Adding dated items
adding.l1: Add → choose Bought-in item, Opened item, Prepared item or Other dated item, or scan a barcode to find the product first.
adding.l2: A product holds what stays the same: name, barcode, category, cost and selling price. Each delivery or batch is a separate dated item with its own date, quantity and place.
adding.l3: Choose the kind of date: use-by, best-before, manufacturer expiry, internal cutoff, quality review or no date. A month-only best-before stays month-only.
adding.l4: An item with no date is shown as Needs checking. It is never shown as fine.
adding.l5: When a barcode also carries a date or lot, the app offers it for you to check against the pack before you save.
adding.l6: Quantity, lot, place, cost and notes are optional.

rules.title: Opened and prepared items
rules.l1: Opened: choose the batch you are opening, how much and when. Only that amount is taken from the original batch.
rules.l2: Prepared: choose the prepared product, when it was made, where it is kept and, if you want, the batches it was made from.
rules.l3: For the deadline, apply one of your business's saved rules or enter the deadline directly. {{app}} has no built-in shelf lives and never suggests one.
rules.l4: Every rule needs a source, such as the pack instructions, a supplier specification or your own written procedure. Set rules up in More → Rules.
rules.l5: If the original pack has an earlier hard date (use-by, expiry or internal cutoff), that earlier date stays in control. Moving an item to a fridge or freezer never extends its date.
rules.l6: Editing a rule does not change items already saved: each item keeps the rule version it was given.

today.title: Today and the date check
today.l1: Today shows what needs attention first: past deadlines, items due today or soon, items with no date and quality reviews.
today.l2: Start date check goes through the list one item at a time: confirm the date, correct it, record what happened or skip.
today.l3: On an item, record Used, Sold, Wasted or Returned. Leave the quantity empty to record all that is left. Wasted asks for a reason.
today.l4: Nothing is counted as wasted just because its date passed. Only what you record appears in the waste report.
today.l5: Every change is kept in the item's History. To fix a mistake, use Correct date or quantity; the reason is saved with it.
today.l6: Archive takes an item off Today without deleting its history. An archived item can be restored.

labelsPrice.title: Labels and price reductions
labelsPrice.l1: For opened and prepared items, Print internal label makes a small label with the name, time, deadline, rule, lot, place and a short note.
labelsPrice.l2: It is an internal label only. It is not a legal food label (not PPDS) and does not replace ingredient, allergen or other consumer labelling.
labelsPrice.l3: The price reduction helper shows exact reduced prices when the product has a cost and a selling price in the same currency.
labelsPrice.l4: It is not offered after a hard deadline such as a use-by has passed, or when the date is unknown. For a best-before, check quality first.
labelsPrice.l5: It only works out prices. It does not decide whether an item may be sold and does not change your prices.

reports.title: Reports, import and export
reports.l1: Reports → Expiry report lists what is due, past its date or needs checking. Filter by dates, status, place, category, product or type of item.
reports.l2: Reports → Waste report lists what you recorded as wasted, with quantity, reason and cost where known. An unknown cost stays unknown.
reports.l3: Each report can be previewed as a PDF or exported as CSV, then shared or saved.
reports.l4: More → Import products or Import dated items reads a CSV file. Check the columns and the preview; nothing is saved until you confirm, and the same file is not imported twice.
reports.l5: More → Export CSV creates product and dated-item files you can open in a spreadsheet.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.l1: More → Reminders: a daily summary at the time you choose, a warning a number of days before, a warning on the day, and a warning before an opened or prepared cutoff time. Reminders are best effort with no guaranteed time: Android may deliver them later than the selected time. Open Today for the current status.
reminders.l2: Reminders are created on this phone. The phone asks once for permission to show notifications.
reminders.l3: Reminder times only decide when you are reminded. They are not shelf-life rules and never change a date.
reminders.l4: Battery saving or Do Not Disturb can delay or hide notifications. Today always shows the current state, so open the app for your date check.
reminders.l5: Reminders are planned ahead and updated each time the app opens or a date changes.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.l1: More → Backup and restore → Create backup makes one .tillexpiry file with every business on this phone, encrypted with a password you choose.
backup.l2: Keep the file off this phone, for example on a cloud drive you trust. Without the password nobody can open it, including us.
backup.l3: To restore, choose the file and enter its password. You see what it contains before anything changes. Restoring replaces all data on this phone.
backup.l4: The demo, reminders already scheduled and the app language are not included. Reminders are planned again after a restore.

support.title: Getting support
support.l1: More → Contact / Support opens an email with your app version and device already filled in.
support.l2: Describe the screen and what you were trying to do. Screenshots help if they show no private information.
support.l3: Never send backup passwords, bank details, store passwords or unredacted product lists.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.a1: No. {{app}} works offline and needs no account. Your records are stored on this device, and files leave the app only when you choose to export, share, print or back them up.
gettingStarted.q2: Does this version have purchases or limits?
gettingStarted.a2: No. This is a review build: every feature is unlocked, and there are no purchases, no subscription and no billing.

dataPrivacy.title: Data & privacy
dataPrivacy.q1: Does {{app}} send my records to a server?
dataPrivacy.a1: No. Your products, dated items and history are not sent to {{app}} servers; there is no account and no cloud. You are responsible for backup files, exports and anything you share outside the app.
dataPrivacy.a2: Yes. Each business has its own products, dated items, places, rules, reports and search results. The demo is kept apart from all of them.

permissions.title: Camera, files & notifications
permissions.q1: Why does the app ask for the camera, files or notifications?
permissions.a1: The camera is used only to read barcodes; no photo is stored. Files are opened only when you import a CSV or restore a backup, and created when you export, print or back up. Notifications are used only for the reminders you turn on.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.q1: What happens if I lose my phone?
troubleshooting.a1: Without a backup, the records on that phone cannot be recovered. Create a backup in More → Backup and restore, keep the file off the phone and remember its password.
troubleshooting.q2: Does deleting the app delete my data?
troubleshooting.a2: Yes. Uninstalling removes the businesses, products, dated items and history stored by the app, unless you backed them up first. Backups and exports saved elsewhere are not affected.

support.title: Contact support
support.a1: Email {{supportEmail}}. More → Contact / Support fills in your app version and device. Add the screen you were on and what you were trying to do.
support.q2: What can I send to support?
support.a2: Your device type, system version, app version, the screen name, a short description and screenshots with private information hidden. Never send backup passwords, bank details, store passwords or unredacted product lists.

dates.title: Dates and rules
dates.q1: What is the difference between use-by and best-before?
dates.a1: In the UK and many other countries, a use-by date relates to food safety and a best-before date relates to quality. {{app}} keeps them apart: a past use-by is shown as needing action, a past best-before as needing a quality review. It never decides whether food may be eaten or sold.
dates.q2: Why does {{app}} not suggest shelf lives?
dates.a2: Shelf life depends on the product, the recipe, storage and your procedures. {{app}} records the dates and rules you enter, each rule with its source, and does not decide or check whether food is fit to eat.
dates.q3: Why is an item marked Needs checking?
dates.a3: It has no date recorded. Items without a date are never shown as fine. Open the item and use Correct date or quantity, or record what happened to it.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.q1: I did not get a reminder.
reminders.a1: Check that notifications are allowed for {{app}} and that battery saving is not stopping them, then open the app once so it can plan reminders again. More → Reminders shows how many are scheduled.
reminders.q2: Do reminder times change my dates?
reminders.a2: No. Reminder times only decide when the phone reminds you. They are not shelf-life rules and never change a date.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {{app}}, provided by {{publisher}}, handles your information.
privacy.p1: {{app}} stores your businesses, products, dated items, rules, places, history and settings on your device. There is no account and no {{app}} server that holds your data. This review build contains no purchases and no billing.
privacy.p2: The app contains no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting libraries. Your products, dated items and history stay on your device and are not sent to TillExpiry servers.
privacy.h3: Device features the app may use
privacy.l1: Camera – only to read barcodes when you open the scanner. No photo is stored.
privacy.l2: Files – when you import a CSV file or restore a backup, and when you create an export, report, label or backup file.
privacy.l3: Sharing and printing – when you send a PDF or CSV to another app, or print a label or report. What you share or print leaves the app and is no longer under its control.
privacy.l4: Language and time zone – read from the phone to show dates and times correctly. They are not sent anywhere.
privacy.l5: App updates – new versions come only through the App Store or Google Play. The app does not download code updates itself.
privacy.l6: Notifications – only for the reminders you turn on. They are scheduled on the device; nothing is sent to a server to create them.
privacy.p7: You are responsible for the files you export, print or share, for your backup files and their passwords, and for your device-level backup settings. Files that leave the app are no longer under its control.
privacy.p3: You can edit, correct, archive or hide your records at any time. Uninstalling the app deletes its data from the device, apart from backups and exports you made yourself.
privacy.p4: Backup files are encrypted with a password you choose. We cannot open or recover them. Where you store them is up to you.
privacy.p5: {{app}} is intended for business users and is not directed at children. {{publisher}} does not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.p8: Do not send your product lists, dates or backup files to support unless they are specifically requested and have been redacted. Never send backup passwords, bank details or store account passwords.
privacy.p9: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected in the app and the date above will be updated; the version in the app is the current one.
privacy.p6: For privacy questions or data requests, contact {{privacyEmail}}.

terms.p7: By downloading or using the app, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

terms.p16: {{app}} does not determine, check or validate the shelf life of any product. It has no built-in shelf lives: every after-opening or preparation rule is entered by you, with its source. Internal labels printed from the app are not legal food labels and do not replace ingredient, allergen or other consumer labelling.

dataStorage.title: Data Storage & Backup Notice
dataStorage.p1: Your businesses, products, dated items, rules, places, history and settings are stored locally on your device.
dataStorage.l1: Deleting the app deletes its locally stored data.
dataStorage.l2: Device loss, damage, reset or uninstall may cause data loss.
dataStorage.l3: Back up regularly from More → Backup and restore, and keep the .tillexpiry file off this phone.
dataStorage.l4: Backup, export, report and label files contain your business records. Store them securely and share them only with people you trust.
dataStorage.l5: Backups are encrypted with the password you choose. If you lose that password, the backup cannot be restored – not by you and not by us.
dataStorage.l6: One backup holds every business on this phone. The demo, reminders already scheduled and the app language are not included. Backups from other apps are rejected.
dataStorage.n1: {{app}} cannot recover locally stored data if the device, the backup password or a usable backup is lost.
dataStorage.p2: To report a security concern, contact {{securityEmail}}. Do not include backup passwords, bank details or unredacted product files in the first report.

recovery.title: Recovery needed before TillExpiry can open
recovery.body: A restore from a backup was interrupted, and the data on this phone could not be put back to how it was before yet.
recovery.bodyUnreadable: A restore from a backup was interrupted, and its recovery record on this phone could not be read, so TillExpiry cannot tell whether your data is complete. The record is kept, not deleted.
recovery.dataHidden: Your business data is not shown until the recovery is complete, so you never work on a half-replaced copy.
recovery.hint: If this keeps happening, make sure the phone has free storage space, restart it and tap Retry again. Do not uninstall the app: that would delete the data it is trying to recover.
recovery.bodyUnconfirmed: A restore from a backup could not confirm that it finished. Until this is settled, the app cannot show or change business data, because anything entered now could be replaced.
